items.claim: Simplify slider: canceling a drag leaves Sand's tolerance at the canceled value
items.note: On Escape the Slider sends the value the drag began from to `onInput` before it calls `onCancel` (`useThumbDrags.ts` `finish`; "Edit callbacks" in `docs/conventions.md`), so `onTolerance` puts the tolerance back. I checked with a throwaway test: drag with the pointer, press Escape, and the slider and Sand's saved tolerance are both back at their start values.

items.claim: Offset slider: canceling a drag leaves the slider at the canceled distance
items.note: for the same reason. `setDistance` gets the start value back before `onCancel`, and the same throwaway test showed it.

items.claim: Picking a color drops an alpha the swatch holds in `opacity`
items.note: The color context now reads alpha through `toolOptionPaint` and `paintAlpha`, and writes paints in `toolOptionPaint`'s spelling (six hex digits, alpha as `opacity`). The same fix covers `focusedAlpha` and `setFocusedAlpha`. `setFocusedColor` now returns the paint it set.

items.claim: A picked color gives the swatch and the selection two different alphas
items.note: `usePickColor` now sends `setFill` or `setStroke` the same `{ paint }` the context just set, as the swatch's own edit does.

items.claim: Live symmetry makes its first group while a redo is pending, which drops the redo
items.note: With no group to draw into, it now waits out a pending redo whether or not it ever held a group. This was a behavior call, so it is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round thirty-five (2026-11-17): draw". The cost: after you turn Symmetry on with a redo pending, the shape that clears the redo is drawn unmirrored. The open P3 TODO about Symmetry being a pref or document state covers the same wait.

items.claim: Simplify/Offset slider cancel leaves the dragged value
items.note: Every Slider cancel path sends the starting value back through `onInput` before calling `onCancel` (`finish` in `useThumbDrags.ts`, and `useRegionDrag.ts`). So `onTolerance`/`setDistance` restore the slider and Sand's tolerance pref. I checked this with a pointer-drag-then-Escape test, which passed, and didn't commit that test.

items.claim: Empty sticky note deleted when its edit ends
items.note: A node with a `background` is now kept.

items.claim: Release Compound's enabled state goes stale on scene edits
items.note: It's now read through a scene subscription.

items.claim: Live symmetry stops mirroring once its group is deleted or undone away
items.note:
This needed a behavior call, which I made and recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round thirty-four":
  - When the group is gone, draw switches to another symmetry group already in the document, or makes a fresh one.
  - While a redo is pending it makes nothing, so undo can still get past the group's creation and redo brings it back. Recreating straight away would have made it impossible to undo past the group.
  - The cost: a shape drawn during that wait isn't mirrored.

items.claim: A page with `width="Infinity"` opens as an infinite page
items.note: A page side must now be finite and positive.

items.claim: The options strip's remembered height goes stale
items.note: A `ResizeObserver` now updates the stored height without panning.
